hero.heading: Built for the Way Deals Actually Happen
hero.description: Vaizen is a licensing marketplace built for the way deals actually happen. Full submission workflow, multi-territory avails engine, advanced search, and role-based access. Built and running.

problem.title: How a $230B Market Still Runs on Email
problem.subtitle: The infrastructure gap Vaizen was built to close

challenges.title: Discovery Is Broken
challenges.description: Rights holders with completed titles have no persistent, searchable layer to reach buyers. Availability lives in spreadsheets and PDFs sent to whoever you met at a market.

challenges.title: Licensing Lives in Email Chains
challenges.description: Avails, territories, and rights windows are negotiated through back-and-forth emails. A buyer in Germany shouldn't need three calls to know if European SVOD rights are available.

challenges.title: Markets Are Gatekeepers
challenges.description: Cannes, AFM, and MIPCOM are expensive, infrequent, and closed-network. The infrastructure connecting indie supply to global demand shouldn't require a hotel room in the South of France.

solution.title: Everything the Market Needed. Nothing It Didn't.
solution.subtitle: A full licensing workflow — built and running

benefits.title: Full Title Submission
benefits.description: Video, metadata, artwork, documents, and licensing availability in one structured workflow. Structured data from the first click — not a form that ends in a PDF attachment.

benefits.title: Multi-Territory Avails Engine
benefits.description: Worldwide, include-list, or exclude-list licensing across 50+ countries. AVOD, SVOD, TVOD, Pay TV, and Free TV supported. Territory configuration is granular and real-time.

benefits.title: Advanced Search
benefits.description: Genre, country of production, cast, director, festival pedigree, content advisory, and release window. Every search returns only titles with declared, available rights.

benefits.title: Role-Based Access
benefits.description: Filmmaker, Producer, Sales Agent, Distributor, Catalog Owner, Buyer, and Film Festival roles — each with appropriate permissions and workflows tailored to how they actually work.

benefits.title: Verified Identity Layer
benefits.description: Every party is verified at registration. Rights holders know who is accessing their screeners. Buyers know they are dealing with legitimate, authenticated rights owners.

variables.title: Supply and Demand, Finally Connected
variables.subtitle: Vaizen closes the gap that has existed since film markets moved online in 2020

items.title: The Rights Holders
items.description: 40,000+ films are produced globally every year. The majority are independent productions with no distribution infrastructure. They have titles, avails, and materials — they just can't reach buyers efficiently. Vaizen solves that.

items.title: The Buyers
items.description: Streaming platforms, broadcasters, and distributors have tripled their acquisition budgets in five years. They need a reliable, searchable source of indie content with declared avails. Vaizen is that source.

metrics.title: The Signals Are Unmistakable
metrics.subtitle: Why now is exactly the right moment to build this infrastructure

items.name: $230B+ Market
items.description: The global content licensing and distribution market. The majority of this value flows through opaque, relationship-dependent channels. Vaizen makes it structural and searchable.

items.name: Streaming Fragmentation
items.description: Dozens of new platforms launched globally since 2020, each competing for indie content. More buyers, same broken discovery infrastructure. The demand has never been greater.

items.name: No Neutral Platform
items.description: Cinando and TVSL are dated and closed-network. There is no Bloomberg Terminal for film rights. That is the gap Vaizen fills — and it is already built.
